title: Design System: Farm to Market — The Trade Instrument

display.purpose: Mastheads, plate headers, page titles, seal initials, grade letters. Identity only, never body copy.

body.purpose: Prose, table cells, form controls. Tabular numerals globally.

serial.purpose: Lot serials, money, timestamps, phone numbers, counts. Money never appears in the document face.

label.purpose: Ledger column heads, field labels, nav, captions. 11px is the functional-text floor.

shadows.name: rule-double
shadows.purpose: The printed second rule under 1px-bordered ledger column heads. Zero blur, always.

shadows.name: stamp-echo
shadows.purpose: The rubber stamp's inner border echo inside its 1.5px outer border.

shadows.name: seal-rings
shadows.purpose: Concentric inset rings on grade seals and avatar seals. REJECT inverts the ring colors.

shadows.name: plate-inset
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink), inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 35%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Hairline inset on solid ink plates. No drop shadows exist anywhere in the system.

motion.name: ease-damped
motion.purpose: The single authored ease for seal-land and route-ink.

motion.name: seal-land
motion.purpose: A seal stamps down (scale 1.45 → 0.94 overshoot → 1 with rotation settle). Payout advice, landed confirmations.

motion.name: route-ink
motion.purpose: Route legs draw themselves in via stroke-dashoffset (--route-len).

motion.name: ember
motion.purpose: Damped gold pulse (opacity 1 → 0.35) on live states. All three families disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink action; the certificate's Place Bid.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #14322b); color: var(--paper, #efebdd); padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-8, #2b463d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a87b23); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14322b); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-5, #718074); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--paper-deep, #e7e1cd); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a87b23); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: Smallcaps-labeled field on lifted paper; focus shifts the border, caret is gold.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-6, #596d61); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3, #aab2a0); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-lift, #f4f1e6); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #14322b); caret-color: var(--gold, #a87b23); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-6, #596d61); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ink-6, #596d61); outline: none; }

components.name: Certificate Card
components.description: The framed certificate panel: doubled frame, smallcaps title over a double ledger rule.
components.html:
Transaction Flow — Mobile Money Escrow

Every lot a certificate, every payment a banknote-grade receipt.
components.css: .ds-certificate { position: relative; background: var(--paper-lift, #f4f1e6); border: 1px solid var(--ink-7, #425a4f); border-radius: 2px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-certificate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-2, #c8cbb6); border-radius: 1px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-cert-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-6, #596d61); padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink-7, #425a4f); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 -1px var(--ink-2, #c8cbb6); } .ds-cert-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #14322b); }

components.name: State Stamp (live)
components.description: A stamped state ticket; live states burn gold with an ember dot.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px currentColor; } .ds-stamp-live { color: var(--gold-ink, #6e4e12); background: var(--gold-wash, #e9ddbe); } .ds-ember { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: ds-ember 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-ember { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ember { animation: none; } }

components.name: Grade Seal
components.description: A/B/C as an engraved double-ring seal; REJECT inverts to paper-on-ink.
components.html: A B C
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; background: var(--paper, #efebdd); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--paper, #efebdd), inset 0 0 0 3px currentColor; font-family: 'Cinzel', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-seal-a { color: var(--ink, #14322b); } .ds-seal-b { color: var(--gold-deep, #8a6318); } .ds-seal-c { color: var(--stamp, #9e3b2c); }

components.name: Stat Figure
components.description: Typed figure over a tracked caption — the instrument's stat idiom.
components.css: .ds-stat { text-align: center; font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold-deep, #8a6318); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-caption { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-6, #596d61); }

components.name: Masthead Nav Tab
components.description: Smallcaps tab on the ink plate; active carries the gold underline.
components.html: MarketplaceOrdersContracts
components.css: .ds-plate-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; background: var(--ink, #14322b); padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-nav-tab { font-family: 'Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-3, #aab2a0); padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--paper, #efebdd); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #a87b23); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--paper, #efebdd); border-bottom-color: var(--gold, #a87b23); }

narrative.overview:
Farm to Market's buyer, farmer, and driver portals are drawn as a security-printed trade instrument (D-039, seed 222cf785): every lot is a certificate, every payment a banknote-grade receipt, every state a stamped seal on ruled paper. The world borrows the cedi banknote's grammar — tinted paper under intaglio-green ink, bronze-gold value figures, oxide-red stamps, engraved guilloché and rosettes as line-work at frames — and applies it to a working marketplace where a trader reads lots the way a teller reads notes. It explicitly refuses two defaults: the white-card agri-SaaS dashboard and its dark-terminal opposite.

Density is document-dense: ledger tables with hairline rows, tracked capital column heads over double rules, typed serials and money in a monospace receipt voice. Ornament is confined to frames and seals; inside the frame, content works without decoration in the way. The same page must survive a sunlit market stall on a mid-range Android phone and an institutional desk on a laptop, so legibility floors (11px functional text, --ink-6 as the lightest functional ink) are part of the system, not an accessibility afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted banknote paper (#efebdd) under intaglio-green ink (#14322b); no white, no black, no gray.
A fixed 9-step ink-on-paper ramp is the only neutral scale.
Bronze-gold for value and live states; oxide-red for stamps, refusals, and disputes.
Engraving (guilloché, rosettes, hatching, line-art vignettes) lives at frames and seals only.
Three type voices: engraved capitals, document text, typed serials — money is always typed.
Square-cornered, double-ruled print furniture; depth is printed, never cast.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: The nine-step ink ramp and the three paper tints are the only neutrals. No gray hex ever enters the file; every "gray" is green ink diluting into paper.

rules.name: The Gold-Ink Rule
rules.body: Gold text at small sizes on tinted washes is set in --gold-ink (#6e4e12), never --gold. Raw --gold (#a87b23) is reserved for strokes, seals, carets, focus rings, large figures, and accents on the dark plate.

rules.name: The Four Stamps Rule
rules.body: Every lifecycle state renders as a stamped ticket in exactly one of four tone families: settled money is intaglio ink on paper, live states burn gold-ink on gold-wash (with an ember dot), refusals and disputes are oxide red on stamp-wash, dormant states fade to --ink-6 on paper. No fifth family.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Cinzel speaks identity, Public Sans speaks the document, Courier Prime speaks serials, money, and timestamps. Money and serials never appear in the document face.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text never drops below 11px (.smallcaps is the floor), and --ink-6 (#596d61) is the lightest ink permitted on functional small text and placeholders. Sunlight legibility on a market-stall phone is the reason; the floor is detector-enforced.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn with lines, tints, and plates — never cast with blur. box-shadow may only appear with zero blur as an inset ring or a printed second rule.

rules.name: The Doubled Line Rule
rules.body: Importance is marked by doubling a hairline, never by merely thickening it. Frames, rules, stamps, and seals all carry their second line.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: No emoji, no icon fonts, no filled glyph sets — a new icon is drawn on the same plate at the same stroke: 24-unit viewBox, currentColor, strokeWidth 1.4, round caps and joins.

rules.name: The Three Motions Rule
rules.body: No fourth animation family; anything that moves is a seal landing, ink drawing, or an ember burning. All three are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do frame every content panel as a certificate: 1px --ink-7 outer rule, 1px --ink-2 hairline inset 3px, 2px corners, --paper-lift interior.
Do set every serial, money figure, timestamp, and phone number in Courier Prime (.serial); large money is serial bold in --gold-deep with a smallcaps unit beside it.
Do keep guilloché, rosettes, and hatching at frames, seals, and empty media wells only — never as content-area texture.
Do stamp every lifecycle state with StateBadge in one of the four tone families; live states get the ember dot.
Do render seller and place identity through the sellerName() / placeName() guards in src/api.ts, so a raw parser string renders as "Verified farmer" — never as a person.
Do keep all three faces self-hosted from public/fonts with real fallback stacks.
donts: Don't introduce a gray, a white, or a black — every neutral is an ink-ramp step or a paper tint.
Don't cast drop shadows or blurs; depth is printed (see The Printed Depth Rule).
Don't round rectangle corners beyond 3px; circles belong to seals alone.
Don't set functional text below 11px or lighter than --ink-6; small gold type on washes uses --gold-ink.
Don't use emoji, icon fonts, or filled glyphs — new icons are engraved on the one plate at stroke 1.4.
Don't add a fourth motion family or any animation that ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
